name: EZ-Bar Curl
summary: A biceps curl with a zig-zag bar whose angled grips let the forearms turn slightly inward. Many lifters find it more comfortable on the wrists and elbows than a straight bar.
setup: Load the EZ bar and hold it on the inner or outer angled grips with palms facing up and forward.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, bar hanging at thigh level and elbows at your sides.
Brace your abs and keep the chest up.
execution: Curl the bar toward your shoulders by bending the elbows only.
Squeeze the biceps at the top without letting the elbows travel forward.
Lower the bar under control until the arms are nearly straight.
cues: Curl the bar toward the collarbone
mistakes: Leaning back to finish the rep: reduce the weight and keep the ribs down.
Gripping too wide on the bar so the wrists flare: use the grip position that keeps your wrists comfortable and straight.
Letting the shoulders shrug up: keep the shoulders relaxed and away from the ears.
Dropping the bar after the top: lower it slowly for about 2-3 seconds.
